changes: Replace the term 'salvage value' with the asset's value after n years, the term the VCE General Mathematics study design uses for this idea.
Add the recurrence form V(n) = V(n-1) × (1 − r), since VCE General Mathematics expects students to model depreciation with recurrence relations as well as the closed form.

changes: Rename 'declining balance depreciation' to 'reducing balance depreciation' throughout, including in Question b, since that is the VCE term.
Write the rule in VCE notation, V_n = R^n × V_0 with R = 1 − r/100, in place of S = V₀(1 − r)ⁿ, and describe V_n as the value after n periods rather than the salvage value.
Note that the rule matches the VCE recurrence relation V_0 = starting value, V_{n+1} = R × V_n, so students can link it to their syllabus.
